info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Prehnitc Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Prehnitc Recliner Catalog Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information about Prehnitc Recliners. This endpoint allows users to input specific attributes and features of the recliner to enhance the product catalog. Typically utilized by product managers and e-commerce teams, this API supports businesses in establishing comprehensive and accurate product listings, improving customer engagement and satisfaction. Ensure seamless integration into your existing catalog management workflows with this streamlined solution.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for the Prehnitc Recliner, enabling you to customize and enhance the product specifications.
